poses.label: Upright
poses.description: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and cup the top of one upright dumbbell at your chest.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Bend your hips and knees together, keeping your heels down and knees in line with your toes.

poses.label: Bottom
poses.description: Stop at a depth you can control with your whole foot on the floor and the dumbbell close to your chest.

poses.label: Stand
poses.description: Push through both feet to rise, keeping the dumbbell close to your chest.

review.checked_by: Codex (poses); Claude (pose review and in-app checks)
checks: Compared the chest-height two-hand hold, hip and knee bend, planted feet and return to standing against NASM. Used a moderate illustrated depth.
Validated joint ranges, equipment anchors, contact and framing through the complete loop.

Claude review: deepened Bottom from thighs well above parallel to about parallel, as the cue asks for as low as you can control; torso kept at 30 degrees or less so the chest stays up behind the dumbbell.
In the app: plays, steps and fits at 320px and 402px with no sideways scroll; contacts and fit checked across the whole loop by node tests/guides.test.mjs.
limitations: The side camera emphasizes depth and foot contact. Use the written cue to judge knee tracking and choose a depth you can control.
The Claude review compared poses with the built-in cue and standard technique; the reference pages could not be opened from the review environment.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
